name: smwgraphics-vanilla-title-screen-logo-letters-numbers
title: Vanilla Title Screen Logo Letters & Numbers
description:
Every letter of the alphabet and the numbers 0-9 in the style of the vanilla SMW Title Screen Logo. I made this because many people asked me if I could do the title screen for them, so this should be easy to use for everyone. Of course you still need to combine the letters to the word you need. Also, so many people helped me with my hacks that I decided to give something back to the community to help other people!

Check the readme for more information.

Credit is appreciated because this took VERY long to make,
but not necessary.
